name: CreativeMath
description: CreativeMath is a benchmark assessing LLMs' ability to propose novel and innovative solutions to mathematical problems after known solutions have been provided. It encompasses problems ranging from middle school curricula to Olympic-level competitions, evaluating creative problem-solving rather than just correctness.
reputation: Accepted at AAAI 2025 with oral presentation (4.6% oral rate); novel approach to evaluating mathematical creativity
notes: LLMs perform well on standard math but creative problem-solving varies considerably; evaluates whether AI can assist humans in developing novel solution approaches beyond known methods.
